_comment: The game sources the paper's 20 collected sessions were played on. Reconstructed by replay verification, not captured at deploy time: the deployed build manifest was written to dist/, which is not tracked. All 1382 episodes across the 20 sessions reproduce headlessly against exactly these hashes and not against any other combination, which is what establishes them. study-audit.mjs uses this as its reference when no local build manifest exists, so a later edit to a study game is reported rather than silently changing what the numbers mean.
